name: Global Layer BV
notes:
Global Layer was founded in 2011 with a mission to provide exceptional connectivity after experiencing firsthand the challenges of slow and unreliable service. Driven by the desire to do better, we built a business dedicated to delivering fast, stable, and high-quality network solutions.

Today, we specialize in large-scale IP and capacity services worldwide, ensuring seamless connectivity for our customers.

If you’re looking for a reliable partner who prioritizes your needs and delivers the quality you deserve, look no further. Get in touch with us and focus on growing your business—we’ll handle the rest.
